item.title: UNION CONSULTATIVE COUNCIL LAW: A Strategic Move for Gen. Min Aung Hlaing?
item.description: Ahead of the parliamentary session in March, the military coup leader Gen Min Aung Hlaing has enacted the Union Consultative Council Law, which some legal experts say could place the council’s authority above that of the president.
